# Calibration models

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from the model cards; do not edit. -->

2 calibration models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: one RGB image. Output: the camera intrinsics `[3, 3]` and, where the model estimates them, the gravity direction in the camera frame, roll, pitch and vertical field of view.

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130; `fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW` measures yours. The summary uses one input, 1080x1920: kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under `torch.compile` and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable ([export](../export.md); memory: the engine's device memory + torch's peak). – = not measured.

Other devices: [Apple M1 Pro 16 GB](../devices/apple-m1-pro-16gb.md), [NVIDIA L4](../devices/l4-22gb.md), [NVIDIA L40S](../devices/l40s-44gb.md), [NVIDIA A10](../devices/a10-22gb.md), [NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB](../devices/a100-sxm4-40gb.md), [NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000](../devices/rtx-pro-6000-96gb.md); [across devices](../benchmarks.md#other-devices).

| model | commercial | kernels time (ms),<br>speed-up vs original | kernels peak memory (MiB, reserved),<br>ratio to original |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`anycalib-pinhole`](#anycalib) | yes | 21.3, 1.8x | 816, 0.6x |
| [`geocalib-pinhole`](#geocalib) | yes | 82.5, 1.3x | 342, 0.61x |

## AnyCalib

AnyCalib (University of Zaragoza, ICCV 2025): the camera of one photo (focal length, principal point, field of view) from one predicted viewing ray per pixel and a fit; no checkerboard needed, no gravity. Apache-2.0 code and weights; trained on crops of public 360-degree panoramas.

Commercial use: yes.

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `anycalib-pinhole` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 38.4<br>29.4<br>21.3<br>25.5<br>fails: ONNX export: conversion failed | 1343 / 1352<br>705 / 742<br>741 / 816<br>719 / 756<br>– |

### Measured

Each image at its own size (1440 x 1920 portrait); roll, pitch and vertical field of view of the fitted camera against the ground truth; AUC of the error up to 5 degrees (errors below 1 degree count as 1, siclib's `compute_auc(min_error=1)`), the GeoCalib paper's protocol. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

| variant | dataset | original fp32 | original fp16 | portable | kernels | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `anycalib-pinhole` | LaMAR2k, all 2000 images, roll / pitch / vertical FoV error AUC@5 degrees % | – / – / 51.6 |  | – / – / 51.6 | – / – / 51.5 |  |
| `anycalib-pinhole` | LaMAR2k, every 10th image (200), roll / pitch / vertical FoV error AUC@5 degrees % | – / – / 48.5 | – / – / 48.5 | – / – / 48.4 | – / – / 48.4 |  |

Measured on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130, fastforks 6637f957, 2026-11-13.

## GeoCalib

GeoCalib (ETH Zurich / Microsoft, 2024): the camera of one photo (focal length, field of view) and how it is tilted (roll, pitch from gravity), from perspective fields and an optimisation; no checkerboard needed. Apache-2.0 code, CC-BY-4.0 weights; training photos of mixed licences.

Commercial use: yes.

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `geocalib-pinhole` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 106<br>82.3<br>82.5<br>73.1<br>fails: ONNX export: torch.export failed | 502 / 558<br>320 / 378<br>279 / 342<br>246 / 300<br>– |
